summary: Iteration 3 testing complete. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass covering Experience DNA, Memory Quality, Similar Experiences w/ component breakdown, What Worked Before, Outcome Variation, enriched Conflicts, Situation clustering, PDF/TXT upload with extraction pipeline, unsupported extension rejection, and legacy CRUD. Frontend: 11/11 flows pass — sectioned sidebar (all 10 nav ids + 6 section headers OVERVIEW/EXPERIENCE MEMORY/RECALL INTELLIGENCE/TRUST & EVIDENCE/DATA/MORE), Dashboard positioning strip + memory-quality widget + gap-0, CaseDetail Experience DNA 6 steps, Recall 'SIMILAR EXPERIENCES' with per-component breakdown (Event/Symptom/Depth/Formation/Parameter + weights), what-worked panel with evidence strength, What Worked Before page, Experience DNA page selector, Conflicts with IMPACT/WHY/STATUS, Alerts flow banner + cluster header + situation-0 populated as 'Torque Escalation' (HIGH) after rule creation, Upload TXT narrative extracted → 4-step pipeline + dna-result, legacy PDF download, nav-dna/nav-what-worked navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown past 1000 lines mixing routes, similarity, LiveHub, upload pipeline, DNA construction; split into routers/{recall,uploads,alerts,dna}.py + services/similarity.py for maintainability.
UPLOADED_CASES / ALERT_RULES / TRIGGERED_ALERTS remain in-memory only despite growing feature reliance on them. Situations/what-worked calls silently return empty after restart. Persist to Mongo.

similarity_components: event_similarity line 63 has a convoluted branch (`round(100.0 if inter == len(ns) == len(ps) else 0, 0) if not (union) else ...`) that is unreachable/confusing when union>0; simplify to a clean Jaccard.
action_family() line 316: `if 'rpm' in t or 'reduced' in t and 'wob' in t` has operator-precedence bug (and binds tighter than or) — likely misclassifies plain 'reduced' mentions. Add parentheses.

evaluate_alerts still fires on every live tick without dedup — a persistent breach spammed 5+ 'Torque Escalation' alerts in the UI situations panel during test (confirms iteration-2 comment still unaddressed).

extract_dna_from_text regex depth accepts up to 6 digits and strips commas via lower() only implicitly — '11,200 ft' worked in the test because 200 matched 3-digits fallback… actually it captured '200' not 11200 (the comma broke the 4-6 digit run). Consider stripping commas before regex to make depth_ft correct.

PDF upload with blank page raises 400 'No text could be extracted' — acceptable but the frontend/CaseUpload will surface this as a raw error; consider a friendlier message + retain filename in response.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed alert rules (deleted in teardown) and uploaded TEST_TXT/TEST_PDF/TEST_SW cases (in-memory, cleared on backend restart).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-3 features (Experience DNA endpoint & page, memory-quality widget, Similar Experiences component breakdown, What Worked Before, Outcome Variation, enriched Conflicts w/ impact+why+status, Situation clustering, PDF/TXT upload w/ narrative DNA extraction) verified end-to-end. Situations require at least one triggered alert first — seed with a low-threshold rule and wait ~8s for live loop or trigger via /uploads with high torque row. Legacy iteration-1/2 features (CSV/LAS upload, alerts CRUD, WebSocket live feed, PDF report download, AI assistant) still work. All in-memory stores clear on backend restart.
